summary: Verification found real contract gaps despite passing existing tests: host normalization and legacy fallback are absent, and hostile localStorage keys can crash listing. Restored the approved specification and capability delta after main drifted them without updating approval digests; route back to implementation for bounded safe parsing, deterministic browser scope, provider then unscoped legacy fallback, and focused tests.
